caption: The drawing depicts a large golden eagle with outstretched wings positioned against a light blue, semi-oval background. The eagle is rendered in shades of yellow and gold, with feather detailing visible on both wings and body. Its beak is open and colored a muted red-orange. The eagle’s talons grip a rock-like form beneath it, painted in shades of blue-gray and green. Across the eagle’s chest is a shield; the top of the shield is blue with three yellow stars, while the rest of the shield is marked with alternating vertical red and white stripes. The entire composition is centered within the semicircular background, and the background itself appears weathered with visible rust and wear marks. The outer area beyond the semi-oval is plain and off-white.
title: Eagle from Paddle Wheel Cover of "Island Home"
